coverage.original_language: Lehrbuch der Algebra Bands 1 and 3 modern LaTeX reader drafts are front-facing.
coverage.translation: Lehrbuch der Algebra Volume II current English draft is front-facing: preface, sections 1-8, and continuations on abelian groups, bases, invariants, group characters, reciprocal groups, Lagrange resolvents, linear substitutions, transposed substitutions, projective actions, binary substitutions, absolute invariants, form problems, Galois groups, metacyclic groups, abstract groups, alternating groups, orthogonal groups, and fractional linear groups. A separate Volume I English draft on invariants and finite binary polyhedral groups is also front-facing.
coverage.proofreading: Working drafts for checking; not certified final critical editions.
